# Notification event types spored sends to spore-bot's POST /notify.
#
# SOURCE OF TRUTH: spore-host/spawn, every `a.notifier.Notify(ctx, "<event>", ...)`
# call (pkg/agent/agent.go, pkg/agent/fsx_mount.go; Notifier is in
# pkg/agent/notifier.go). Find them with:
#
#   git -C <spawn> grep -nE 'Notify\([^,]+, *"' -- '*.go'
#
# plus any event chosen by variable (idle_stopped/idle_hibernated in
# idleTimeoutReached). When spawn adds an event, add it here AND give it an
# explicit case in formatNotification (notify.go), buildDiscordEmbed
# (discord.go) and twilioMessage (sms_notify.go); TestSporedEventsHandled fails
# until all three agree with this list. To check this list against a spawn
# checkout: SPAWN_SRC=/path/to/spawn go test -run TestSporedEventsMatchSpawn .
#
# One event per line; '#' starts a comment.

ttl_warning
ttl_expired
idle_warning
idle_stopped
idle_hibernated
idle_stop_failed   # spawn#948 / spawn PR #977 (spore-host#558)
completion_stop_failed  # spawn#978 / spawn PR #1005 (spore-host#563)
completion
spot_interrupt
pre_stop_start
pre_stop_failed
pre_stop_timeout
region_vacated     # spawn#260
fsx_mount_failed
fsx_dra_failed     # spawn#194, #622
spot_replacement_retired   # spawn#995 / spawn PR #1008
